The [VaxLink](https://fredhersch.github.io/vaxlink/) walkthrough
([source](https://github.com/fredhersch/vaxlink)) shows sample FHIR payloads in
its payload drawer and on its device screens S1 to S8. This page maps each of
them to the example in this guide that materializes it, so the walkthrough can
load the published examples instead of its own copies.

Every example is published twice: as a page, and as raw JSON at a stable URL
the walkthrough can fetch (`https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/<Type>-<id>.json`).
They are FHIR R4 (4.0.1), as this guide is, like smart-base and the Personal Health Wallet guide.

### Country profiles

Each country records only what its own step needs, so the guide has a small profile per country where the two differ. Each profile's description says how it is used in the journey and why its constraints are there. These are demonstrator profiles: they show what each step relies on and are not a ministry's national specification.

| Country | Moment | Profile | Why it is there | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Thailand | J1 | [TrustDemoThPatient](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoThPatient.html) | The birth hospital's newborn: a hospital number, since a baby of Lao parents has no Thai citizen id. | [TrustDemoThSomsack](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Patient-TrustDemoThSomsack.html) |
| Thailand | J1 | [TrustDemoThImmunization](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoThImmunization.html) | A birth dose with every field the signed DVC (HCERT) carries: product, date, lot, dose number, performer. | [TrustDemoJ1HepB](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Immunization-TrustDemoJ1HepB.html), [TrustDemoJ1Bcg](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Immunization-TrustDemoJ1Bcg.html) |
| Thailand | J4.1 | [TrustDemoThVhlReceipt](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoThVhlReceipt.html) | What the Thai clinic keeps when it views a Lao summary through a VHL: viewed, not copied. | [TrustDemoJ41Received](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Provenance-TrustDemoJ41Received.html) |
| Lao PDR | J2 | [TrustDemoLaoPatient](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoLaoPatient.html) | The child the CHW registers, under a temporary id until civil registration catches up. | [TrustDemoSomsack](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Patient-TrustDemoSomsack.html) |
| Lao PDR | J2b | [TrustDemoLaoHousehold](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoLaoHousehold.html) | The household roster, which is how a CHW notices a missing newborn. | [TrustDemoHousehold](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Group-TrustDemoHousehold.html) |
| Lao PDR | J2b | [TrustDemoLaoRegistration](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoLaoRegistration.html) | The answers on the offline registration form (Structured Data Capture), kept so the extracted records trace back to them. | [TrustDemoJ2Registration](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/QuestionnaireResponse-TrustDemoJ2Registration.html) |
| Lao PDR | J2b | [TrustDemoLaoReportedImmunization](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoLaoReportedImmunization.html) | A foreign dose read without verification: primarySource false, the family as source, not counted by the schedule. | [TrustDemoJ2HepBReported](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Immunization-TrustDemoJ2HepBReported.html), [TrustDemoJ2BcgReported](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Immunization-TrustDemoJ2BcgReported.html) |

| Lao PDR | J3a | [TrustDemoLaoDvcVerification](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/StructureDefinition-TrustDemoLaoDvcVerification.html) | Who verified which DVC against the GDHCN trust list, and which reported doses it replaced. | [TrustDemoJ3Verification](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Provenance-TrustDemoJ3Verification.html) |

### The payload drawer

The keys of the walkthrough's `MOCK_FHIR_RESOURCES`
(`src/data/storylineData.ts`) and the example that replaces each one:

| Key | Type | Example | What changed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patient` | Patient | [TrustDemoSomsack](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Patient-TrustDemoSomsack.html) ([json](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/Patient-TrustDemoSomsack.json)) | Temporary-id system is this guide's (`http://smart.who.int/trust-demo/sid/lao-temporary-id`), not a ministry URL. |
| `group` | Group | [TrustDemoHousehold](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Group-TrustDemoHousehold.html) ([json](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/Group-TrustDemoHousehold.json)) | `actual = true`; the members are Patients (FHIR R4 Group lists Patients, so each parent is a Patient beside their RelatedPerson role); the household code is `FAMMEMB` with the text "Household". |
| `immunizationHepB` | Immunization | [TrustDemoJ3HepB](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Immunization-TrustDemoJ3HepB.html) ([json](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/Immunization-TrustDemoJ3HepB.json)) | Both codings, as on the walkthrough's payload; plus CVX `08`. The product and schedule code systems are this guide's illustrative stand-ins. |
| `serviceRequest` | ServiceRequest | [TrustDemoJ2Referral](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/ServiceRequest-TrustDemoJ2Referral.html) ([json](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/ServiceRequest-TrustDemoJ2Referral.json)) | Code is SNOMED CT `3457005` (patient referral) with the walkthrough's text; the verification reason stays in `reasonCode`. |
| `provenance` | Provenance | [TrustDemoJ3Verification](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/Provenance-TrustDemoJ3Verification.html) ([json](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/Provenance-TrustDemoJ3Verification.json)) | Verifier, enterer and author agents; the DVCs as source entities and the reported doses as removed. The COSE signature stays in the DVC rather than in `Provenance.signature`. |
| `auditEvent` | AuditEvent | [TrustDemoJ41Access](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/artifact/AuditEvent-TrustDemoJ41Access.html) ([json](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-demo/AuditEvent-TrustDemoJ41Access.json)) | R4 shape: `type`, `subtype`, `outcome`, `outcomeDesc`; the receiver is the requestor, the Lao gateway the custodian and observer. The passcode is never logged. |
| `cborPayload` | (not FHIR) | — | The DVC payload is an HCERT (CBOR/COSE), not a FHIR resource; its logical model is smart-trust-phw's DVCMinPreQual. It waits for bean ig01 before it is an example here. |

### What the examples change from the walkthrough's copies

- **Code systems.** The walkthrough's product codes (`vp-hepb-peds-monovalent` and so on) and Lao schedule codes (`LAO-EPI-HEPB-BD` and so on) are illustrative. They are defined here as the code systems `TrustDemoVaccineProduct` and `TrustDemoLaoEpiSchedule`, marked experimental, under this guide's canonical, so no URL implies a real ministry or a real WHO code system.
- **Countries.** Thailand is played on the GDHCN DEV network by test participant XXR and Lao PDR by the fictional XXH. Neither is a production key.
- **The passcode.** The walkthrough shows `4829` on screen. No example stores a passcode: the consent and audit records say only that one was checked.
- **Dates.** As in the walkthrough: birth 2025-10-28, J2 2025-11-18, J3 2025-11-25, the Lao doses 2025-12-10 and 2026-07-28, the trip 2026-10-28.
